## IMQDelay.unit property

Time unit of [IMQDelay.timer](/api/rpc/latest/rpc.imqdelay.timer/) — milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours or days. Defaults to `'ms'`<!-- -->, meaning `timer` is already a millisecond count.

**Signature:**

```typescript
unit: 'ms' | 's' | 'm' | 'h' | 'd';
```
